scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace server && npm run coverage --workspace client
scripts.rewrite:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @battlecity/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @battlecity/sim-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @battlecity/server-ts && npm run typecheck --workspace @battlecity/client-ts
scripts.rewrite:check: npm run rewrite:typecheck && npm run rewrite:test && npm run rewrite:event-inventory && npm run rewrite:complexity && npm run rewrite:duplication && npm run rewrite:cycles && npm run rewrite:maintainability
scripts.rewrite:check:strict: npm run rewrite:typecheck && npm run rewrite:test && npm run rewrite:event-inventory:strict && npm run rewrite:complexity:strict && npm run rewrite:duplication:strict && npm run rewrite:cycles:strict && npm run rewrite:maintainability:strict
